Creates a text node from the included text file content and stores the node pointer in txtTab via xmlXIncludeAddTxt.
Vulnerable code stores xmlNodePtr in txtTab array. The fix changes this to store xmlChar* string copies via xmlStrdup.

fine_trace.note: Reader frees the previous node when moving to the next node, but only when in_xinclude == 0. The text node from the first XInclude is freed when the Reader moves past XML_XINCLUDE_END and in_xinclude returns to 0.

fine_trace.note: Frees the text node and its content. After this, the pointer stored in txtTab becomes dangling.
Second XInclude referencing the same text URL finds the cached entry in txturlTab and calls xmlCopyNode on the freed text node pointer, causing use-after-free.
